name: quality-lock-for-kick
description: Locks Kick.com streams to the quality you choose. Chrome, Zen and Firefox.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --firefox /Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --start-url https://kick.com/
